title: Trump Comments on Possible Pardon for Nvidia Co-Founder
excerpt: According to reports, the President stated that pardoning Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang is considered an option.
body_html:
In a recent exclusive interview, the President addressed the possibility of issuing a pardon for Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang, describing the action as an option.

However, the report notes that the President also stated he does not believe such a measure will ultimately be necessary.
